description: This horizontal bar chart, titled “Distribution of deceived conversations across scenarios,” illustrates the number of conversations categorized by deception level for four distinct scenarios: Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism. The vertical axis lists these scenarios in descending order of total conversation count, from top to bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Conversations,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. A legend in the upper right corner indicates that red bars represent “Deceived: Yes,” yellow bars represent “Deceived: Partially,” and green bars represent “Deceived: No.” For Academic Collaboration, the red bar (Yes) extends to approximately 37, the yellow bar (Partially) to approximately 27, and the green bar (No) to approximately 6. For Recruitment, the red bar (Yes) extends to approximately 38, the yellow bar (Partially) to approximately 24, and the green bar (No) to approximately 6. For Academic Funding, the red bar (Yes) extends to approximately 62, the yellow bar (Partially) to approximately 5, and the green bar (No) to approximately 3. For Journalism, the red bar (Yes) extends to approximately 15, the yellow bar (Partially) extends to approximately 48, and the green bar (No) to approximately 6. The bars are not sorted by any specific criterion other than their position in the legend order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
